jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>Anthropic exists to ensure the world safely navigates the transition through transformative AI. That work is funded by commercial revenue — and every dollar of it runs through Billing Platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that turns product usage into revenue across everything Anthropic ships: Claude.ai, the Developer Platform, Claude Code, and all that comes next. The faster we can price it, charge for it, and account for it correctly, the faster Anthropic can fund the mission.</p> <p>Pricing Foundations is the team within Billing that turns a signed enterprise agreement into something every system can act on. We own the model and the systems of record for what a customer bought: their commitments, their pricing terms, how many organizations roll up to one agreement, and the automation that provisions a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold. When a deal closes, our systems decide what the customer is entitled to, what they pay, and what Finance reports.</p> <p>We're looking for an engineering manager to lead this team. You'll hire and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own how it delivers. Success looks like new deal structures shipping as configuration rather than one-off engineering, and signed deals provisioning automatically, with the rare exception routed to someone who can fix it.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team.</strong> Hire, coach, and develop engineers, give clear and honest feedback, and build a team that owns its domain end to end.</li> <li><strong>Own the commercial data model.</strong> Set the direction for how commitments, pricing terms, account hierarchies, and entitlements are modeled, so a new deal structure extends the model instead of working around it.</li> <li><strong>Own the pricing primitives:</strong> the catalog of products and rates, and the constructs that let contracted pricing follow a customer across products and new model launches.</li> <li><strong>Make the contract the source of truth.</strong> Build systems of record that Finance can close the books on and trace back to the signed contract, with reconciliation against the CRM and every downstream billing system designed in from the start.</li> <li><strong>Automate the path from signature t

jobs.description: <p>P-1492</p> <p>At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started in&nbsp;<strong>Bengaluru , India</strong> ! As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale.</p> <h3>The Role :&nbsp;</h3> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Software Engineer with a deep understanding of low-level systems to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and optimizing application frameworks&nbsp; that form the building blocks for all software development at Databricks. This is not a full-stack role; your expertise will be focused on the intricate details of system internals, performance, and efficiency.</p> <h3>What we look for :&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and maintain core system infrastructure and low-level software components.</li> <li>Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability through meticulous analysis and innovative solutions.</li> <li>Work with JVM internals, memory management, concurrency, and distributed systems.</li> <li>Collaborate with other senior engineers and architects to define technical strategies and roadmaps.</li> <li>Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.</li> <li>Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and architectural decision-making.</li> <li>Troubleshoot complex system issues and provide effective resolutions.</li> </ul> <h3>Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>12+ years of professional experience in software development.</li> <li><strong>Deep understanding of Java Virtual Machine (JVM) internals, including garbage collection, JIT compilation, class loading, and memory model.</strong></li> <li>Proficiency in at least one JVM language and extensive experience with its runtime environment.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Scala/Java/Rust or other systems-level languages.</li> <li>Extensive experience with operating system concepts; including proces
